scope: Dedicated Search navigation and All, Unplayed, Played browse filters

temporaryLibraryFlowHarness.scope: Actual ViewModels, ImageCache, API and CommunityToolkit.Mvvm in a temporary net10.0 xUnit project with only the WinUI Visibility enum stubbed. Synthetic HttpMessageHandler responses; no real Emby server or Windows UI was contacted.
newCoverage: Entering empty Search, submitting empty text, clearing existing search results and refreshing empty Search make no media requests and remain on Search

Library to Search to movie details and back restores the query, search filter, results and original library filter without duplicate history; repeated ShowSearch preserves the existing query and cards
Nonempty searches request all eight supported media types and the subtitle includes the result count and query
All omits IsPlayed, Unplayed sends false and Played sends true; the legacy Boolean overload remains compatible
A failed watch-filter change restores committed Played options and subsequent paging uses those options
Rapid watch-filter changes reject an older response and page the final committed query
An old pending library filter cannot populate or filter a newly opened Search page
temporaryLibraryFlowHarness.warnings: Existing temporary harness tests emit xUnit1051 suggestions for default CancellationToken usage. New Search and watch-status tests use the test cancellation token.

limitations: These results verify managed query, navigation and transaction behavior. Native XAML compilation, keyboard interaction and visual layout are validated separately by the integrating agent.
